empty.purpose: Placeholder describing what the Overview will hold, until its features arrive.
empty.where: Overview screen, when the Library has tracks (first-run flow not shown).
empty.approved: Your Library at a glance, and what to do next.

header.unreadable.purpose: Says why Send is greyed out.
header.unreadable.where: Overview header, beside Send, when the Library can't be read.

header.exportRead.purpose: Says when the export was read, under what the send review's last read found. Kept apart from that text so a full stop never comes before it.
header.exportRead.where: Overview header, under the line that says what the last read found.

numbers.tracks_one.purpose: Names the Library's track count in the first of the four numbers.
numbers.tracks_one.where: Overview, the four numbers, under the count of tracks.

numbers.tracks_other.purpose: Names the Library's track count in the first of the four numbers.
numbers.tracks_other.where: Overview, the four numbers, under the count of tracks.

numbers.length.purpose: The Library's total length, for an hour or more.
numbers.length.where: Overview, the four numbers, under the count of tracks.

numbers.lengthMinutes.purpose: The Library's total length, under an hour.
numbers.lengthMinutes.where: Overview, the four numbers, under the count of tracks.

numbers.inCrates.purpose: Names the count of Library tracks that are in at least one crate.

numbers.analyzed.purpose: Names the count of Library tracks rekordbox supplied a BPM or a key for.

numbers.analyzedUnread.purpose: Says why there is no count of analyzed tracks: rekordbox has not been read, so none could be.
numbers.analyzedUnread.where: Overview, the four numbers, in place of the analyzed count before the first read of rekordbox.

numbers.lastSent.purpose: Names the date the Library was last sent to rekordbox.

numbers.neverSent.purpose: Says the Library was never sent to rekordbox.
numbers.neverSent.where: Overview, the four numbers, in place of the date of the last send.

charts.energy.title.purpose: Heading of the bars that count tracks per energy, 1 to 10.

charts.energy.none.purpose: Label of the bar that counts tracks with no energy.

charts.energy.door_one.purpose: Name of an energy bar's link, for one track: the bar's energy and its count. The link opens the Library with that energy.
charts.energy.door_one.where: Overview, energy bars (screen readers only: the name of the link a bar is).

charts.energy.door_other.purpose: Name of an energy bar's link: the bar's energy and its count. The link opens the Library with that energy.
charts.energy.door_other.where: Overview, energy bars (screen readers only: the name of the link a bar is).

charts.energy.noneDoor_one.purpose: Name of the No energy bar's link, for one track. The link opens the Library with the tracks that have no energy.
charts.energy.noneDoor_one.where: Overview, energy bars (screen readers only: the name of the link a bar is).

charts.energy.noneDoor_other.purpose: Name of the No energy bar's link. The link opens the Library with the tracks that have no energy.
charts.energy.noneDoor_other.where: Overview, energy bars (screen readers only: the name of the link a bar is).

charts.energy.empty.purpose: Says no track has an energy, so there are no bars to draw.
charts.energy.empty.where: Overview, in place of the energy bars.

charts.genres.title.purpose: Heading of the bars that count tracks per genre.

charts.genres.other.purpose: Label of the bar that adds up the genres too small to have a bar of their own.
charts.genres.other.where: Overview, genre bars, after the biggest genres.

charts.genres.none.purpose: Label of the bar that counts tracks with no genre.

charts.genres.empty.purpose: Says no track has a genre, so there are no bars to draw.
charts.genres.empty.where: Overview, in place of the genre bars.

outside.title.purpose: Heading of the strip about the tracks in All music that are not in the Library.

outside.tracks_zero.purpose: Says no track in All music is outside the Library.

outside.tracks_one.purpose: Counts the tracks in All music that are not in the Library.

outside.tracks_other.purpose: Counts the tracks in All music that are not in the Library.

outside.decisions_zero.purpose: Says Review holds nothing that waits for a decision.

outside.decisions_one.purpose: Counts the items in Review that wait for a decision.

outside.decisions_other.purpose: Counts the items in Review that wait for a decision.

outside.manageFolders.purpose: Takes the user down to the music folders panel on the same screen.
outside.manageFolders.where: Overview, Outside your Library, beside the links to Review and All music.

todo.title.purpose: Heading of the list of things waiting for the DJ.

todo.review.purpose: One Review group with items waiting. Opens Review. The group name is the one Review shows.
todo.review.where: Overview to-do list, one line per Review group that has items.

todo.lowQuality_one.purpose: Counts Library tracks whose linked file is flagged for quality. Opens the Library.

todo.lowQuality_other.purpose: Counts Library tracks whose linked file is flagged for quality. Opens the Library.

todo.missingTags_one.purpose: Counts Library tracks with no title, no artist or no genre. Opens the Library.

todo.missingTags_other.purpose: Counts Library tracks with no title, no artist or no genre. Opens the Library.

todo.missingArt_one.purpose: Counts Library tracks whose linked file has no embedded cover. Opens the Library.

todo.missingArt_other.purpose: Counts Library tracks whose linked file has no embedded cover. Opens the Library.

todo.notAnalyzed_one.purpose: Counts Library tracks rekordbox gave neither a BPM nor a key. Only after rekordbox has been read. Opens the Library.

todo.notAnalyzed_other.purpose: Counts Library tracks rekordbox gave neither a BPM nor a key. Only after rekordbox has been read. Opens the Library.

todo.inNoCrate_one.purpose: Counts Library tracks in no crate. Opens the Library.

todo.inNoCrate_other.purpose: Counts Library tracks in no crate. Opens the Library.

todo.outsideLibrary_one.purpose: Counts the tracks in All music that are not in the Library. Opens All music.

todo.outsideLibrary_other.purpose: Counts the tracks in All music that are not in the Library. Opens All music.

todo.lineCounting.purpose: Says a line's number can still change because background work is running.
todo.lineCounting.where: Overview to-do list, after a line's text.

todo.counting.purpose: Says the list isn't complete yet: the numbers are still being worked out.
todo.counting.where: Overview to-do list, while the numbers load or background work is counting.

todo.empty.where: Overview to-do list, when every number is in and none is waiting.

progress.line.purpose: The progress line: what was prepared in the last 7 days.
